caption: The video captures a top-down view of three clear glass cups aligned in a row on a pale surface, with two black forks laid across the middle cup so that their tines interlock at the center. A single translucent, pale blob-like object with a glossy surface is suspended at this junction, already turning as the excerpt opens. The cups, forks, and their soft shadows hold fixed positions throughout the visible span. The central object rotates slowly about its own center, its apparent silhouette shifting from a tall, narrow vertical form to a more tilted and rounded horizontal mass. A faint row of refracted tine-reflections travels across its curved surface in step with the turn. Small specular glints appear and drift along the glossy skin, marking the continuous spin rather than any translation of the object. The camera stays stationary, leaving the glassware, interlocked forks, and pale background unchanged while only the suspended blob reorients. The motion reads as a smooth, ongoing turn, already underway at the first frame and still in progress at the last. Nothing enters or leaves the scene.
relations: A translucent blob at the interlocking fork junction rotates about its center, shifting its silhouette from vertical to horizontal.
During the turn, refracted tine-reflections and specular glints travel across the glossy surface in step with the rotation.
The glass cups, interlocked forks, and soft shadows remain fixed throughout the stationary camera view.
